description:
Yult's follow up to 'Opposite Influence' sees the frenetic and cinematic producer team up with guest vocalist Tanya Auclair for 'The Animal Inside'E.P.
Crystallising the essence of their new live project – here are 4 tracks from the brooding and visceral 2-headed beast.

Yult's playfulness and obsession with sound 'crafting' shows an affinity with the dark and experimental. While Tanya’s voice tempers the edges, disarmingly instinctive, an expressive storyteller addressing themes of internal struggle, paranoia, pride and duality, with lyrics inspired by as diverse sources as William Blake, David Lynch, George Clinton to old British soldier songs from WW2.

“A most modern take on the sweetness of Siouxsie Sioux or early Cure” Daedelus / Ninja Tune
“Cinematic, music that takes you to another place!” Eric Lau / Ubiquity
"Pack your bags! Yult is taking us on an amazing journey!” Xrabit / Big Dada
“A mysterious blend, at once familiar and alien. It is a little sinister. It is night music. It is dope” Natural Self / Tru Thoughts
